report: In a study of 400 responses per contractor, households rated contractor A 0.29 points higher than contractor B on the 10-point scale (95% interval 0.03 to 0.55). A gap of this size would be unusual if the contractors were the same, so we conclude that A is rated higher. Whether the gap reaches the contract's threshold of 0.5 points is not settled: the interval includes 0.5, the estimate is below it, and the study covers surveyed households of this year only.
